mapper.select: SELECT STAFF_SQ, STATUS_CD, SEQ_NO, ORG_NM, DEPT_NM, POSITION_NM, STAFF_NM, RRN_ENC, PHONE, EMAIL, ADDR, STATION , JOIN_DT, LEAVE_DT, HS_NM, HS_MAJOR, HS_GRAD, UNIV_NM, UNIV_MAJOR, UNIV_GRAD, FINAL_EDU , MIL_IN_DT, MIL_OUT_DT, MIL_EXEMPT, EDU_NM, EDU_START_DT, EDU_END_DT, EDU_ORG, CERT_DT, BANK_NM, ACCOUNT_ENC , DOC_REG, DOC_ID, DOC_GRAD, DOC_BANK, DOC_PHOTO, DOC_HI, DOC_CONTRACT, DOC_BIZ, DOC_EI, DOC_SEC , DOC_EDU, DOC_NEP, DOC_PRIV, DOC_CRIME, DOC_MIL , EMG_REL1, EMG_TEL1, EMG_REL2, EMG_TEL2, PREV_CAREER, HOBBY, LANG_SKILL, SPECIALTY, MEMO , SCORE, GAPIL_YN, AUTO_APLY_YN, GRADE_NM, REAL_CAREER, WISH_PRICE, SK_FE, SK_BE, WORK_DOMAIN, WISH_LOC , ETC1, SK_LANG, REPORT, SK_FW, SK_DB, SK_IDE, SK_VCS, ETC2, EXPERTISE, SK_OS FROM TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_M ORDER BY STATUS_CD DESC, JOIN_DT DESC, STAFF_SQ DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_M (STATUS_CD, STAFF_NM, ORG_NM, DEPT_NM, POSITION_NM, PHONE, JOIN_DT, UPDT_EMPLY_ID, UPDT_DT) VALUES (#{STATUS_CD}, #{STAFF_NM}, NULLIF(#{ORG_NM}, ''), NULLIF(#{DEPT_NM}, ''), NULLIF(#{POSITION_NM}, ''), NULLIF(#{PHONE}, ''), NULLIF(#{JOIN_DT}, ''), #{UPDT_EMPLY_ID}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_M SET DRIVE_FOLDER_ID = #{DRIVE_FOLDER_ID} WHERE STAFF_SQ = #{STAFF_SQ}
mapper.select: SELECT DOC_SQ, STAFF_SQ, DOC_CD, FILE_ID, FILE_NM, MIME_TYPE, WEB_LINK, DATE_FORMAT(REG_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS REG_DT FROM TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_DOC_R WHERE STAFF_SQ = #{STAFF_SQ} ORDER BY DOC_CD, DOC_SQ
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_DOC_R (STAFF_SQ, DOC_CD, FILE_ID, FILE_NM, MIME_TYPE, WEB_LINK, REG_EMPLY_ID, REG_DT) VALUES (#{STAFF_SQ}, #{DOC_CD}, #{FILE_ID}, #{FILE_NM}, #{MIME_TYPE}, #{WEB_LINK}, #{UPDT_EMPLY_ID}, NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_DOC_R WHERE DOC_SQ = #{DOC_SQ} AND STAFF_SQ = #{STAFF_SQ}
mapper.select: SELECT PRJ_SQ, STAFF_SQ, PRJ_NM, CLIENT_NM, WORK_NM, ROLE_NM, START_YM, END_YM, IND_NM, APP_NM, MACHINE_NM, OS_NM, LANG_NM, DBMS_NM, TOOL_NM, FRAMEWORK_NM, ETC_NM FROM TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_PRJ_R WHERE STAFF_SQ = #{STAFF_SQ} ORDER BY END_YM IS NULL DESC, START_YM DESC, PRJ_SQ DESC
